findings.issue: יָנוּס is qal imperfect 3ms and אֲשֶׁר … שָׁמָּה marks the place. «que huirá» makes the relative antecedent the one who flees, so the slayer is no longer the subject.
אֵת marks גְּבוּל as the object of יֵצֵא. Bare «salir el límite» leaves that object relation unclear.

notes: Cognate infinitive, conjunction, slayer, and construct chain are otherwise matched.
